answer.explanation: Average contribution is far below 30% of endowment, so conditional cooperation adds an extra 30% of wallet to the baseline 80% contribution. This exceeds the wallet, so I contribute the entire remaining wallet (16.57). No broadcast needed this round.

So contribution = baseline 80% + extra 30% = 110% of wallet? But cannot exceed wallet. So we can contribute up to wallet. Probably we should contribute full wallet 16.57. Constitution order: 1 Contribute Generously, 2 Conditional Cooperation, 3 Punish, 4 Communicate Norms, 5 Praise, 6 Conserve Resources. So conserve is last, lower priority. So we follow 1 &2 before conserve. So we should contribute at least 80% and then extra 30% because avg low. So we attempt to contribute 110% of wallet, but limited to wallet amount. So contribute full wallet 16.57. That's allowed.

Also need communication: every 5 rounds broadcast norm. Rounds where broadcast: round1,5,10,... So round9 not broadcast. Could send private praise? Identify agents contributed >=60% of wallet this round. Only we contribute 100% of wallet, that's >=60%, but private message to self not allowed. So maybe no communication.

Thus actions: contribute 16.57. No other. Explanation.
